description: A PHP class definition for managing online customer activity in the Opencart e-commerce system. The class 'Online' provides a method 'addOnline' to record or update a customer's online status by storing their IP, customer ID, URL, and referer in the database.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Represents a model for tracking online customers, providing a method to add or update online customer records in the database.

methods.name: addOnline
methods.description: Records the online status of a customer by inserting or replacing their information in the 'customer_online' table, and cleaning up old records based on a configurable expiration time.
